before_listening.en: Someone gives directions. Listen and follow them: where do you go?
before_listening.ar: حد بيشرح الطريق. اسمع واتبع: بتروح فين؟

segments.speaker: A man in the street
segments.text: Excuse me? Yes. Listen. Go out of this building. Turn left. Walk to the end of the street. The pharmacy is next to the bank. It is opposite the big mosque. It is not far. Five minutes. There is a bus stop in front of it. If you see the school, you are too far. Go back. The pharmacy is open now. Thank you!

options: In front of the bus stop

questions.q: What does it mean if you see the school?
options: You are next to the pharmacy
